# Anny

> Anny is an AI search visibility and generative engine optimization (GEO) analytics platform for marketing teams. Track how often ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and other models mention your brand — plus which sources they cite, how you compare to competitors, and actionable steps and insights to close the gaps it finds.

## What Anny is

Anny is AI search analytics for marketing teams. Customers ask AI assistants instead of (or before) Google. Anny shows how often models mention a brand, which sources they cite, and what to do to get mentioned more.

Anny is not a classic SEO crawler. It focuses on AI answers, citations, and GEO workflows — similar in spirit to Ahrefs, but for AI answers rather than backlinks and SERPs.

### Core capabilities

- Brand mention / visibility scoring across AI answers
- Citation and source tracking in model responses
- Gap detection with actionable steps and insights to improve visibility
- Multi-model coverage: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Mode / AI Overview, and related engines
- Competitor scorecards on shared prompts
- Daily tracking and prompt sets
- Agency multi-client workspaces and white-label reporting

## Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

GEO is the process of optimizing content and strategy so AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini mention a business when people ask for recommendations. SEO helps you rank higher on Google; GEO helps you get recommended more often by AI/LLMs.

## FAQ

### What does Anny actually do?

Anny shows you if your company gets mentioned in AI answers when people ask AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and more for recommendations. It shows you gaps and opportunities to improve your AI visibility. Think of it sort of like Ahrefs, but for AI answers.

### What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is the process of optimizing your content and strategy so AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini mention your business when people ask for recommendations. Just like SEO helps you rank higher on Google, GEO helps you get recommended more often by AI/LLMs.

### What is a response in Anny?

Each time we generate an AI answer from any model (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.), it counts as 1 response. All models use the same amount — 1 response per query, making it simple to track your usage.

### Do I need to install anything or change my website?

Nope! No code, no plugins, no website changes needed. Just enter your URL and start tracking.

### What's a good Visibility Score?

- 80-100%: Excellent — Your brand dominates AI responses.
- 60-79%: Good — Strong presence with room for improvement.
- 40-59%: Fair — Your brand appears regularly but not prominently.
- 20-39%: Poor — Limited AI visibility.
- 0-19%: Critical — Your brand rarely appears in AI responses.

## Free tools

### Domain Rating checker — https://anny.dodoxhq.com/tools/domain-rating-checker

Free Ahrefs Domain Rating lookup. DR is Ahrefs’ 0–100 score for how strong a site’s backlinks are compared with other sites in Ahrefs’ index. It is not Moz Domain Authority (DA, 1–100, ranking-likelihood model) and not Semrush Authority Score (links + traffic + spam checks). Ahrefs says DR is relative, logarithmic, based on unique followed referring domains, and does not include traffic, spam, or domain age. Google does not use it. Paste a domain (full URLs are fine). No account. Anny is the GEO product; this page is a public utility. Scores are Domain Rating by Ahrefs.

## Compare

### Anny vs Ahrefs — https://anny.dodoxhq.com/compare/ahrefs

Ahrefs is SEO-first (backlinks, keyword research, technical crawl). Anny is built for AI answer visibility, citations, and GEO across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more.

Pick Anny when buyers ask ChatGPT or Gemini before they Google; you need to know which articles AI cites; marketing owns AI visibility as a channel.

Pick Ahrefs when backlinks, content gaps, and technical SEO are still the primary KPI; you need deep crawl history and SERP datasets; AI answer tracking is a nice-to-have.

### Anny vs Semrush — https://anny.dodoxhq.com/compare/semrush

Semrush is an all-in-one marketing suite. Anny is purpose-built for AI answer visibility and GEO.

Pick Anny when AI search is a first-class channel; you want crisp mention/source/model coverage without suite bloat; the team already has SEO tooling and needs a GEO layer.

Pick Semrush when one vendor for SEO, PPC, content, and social is required; AI visibility is secondary to classic rankings; budget already centers on Semrush.

### Anny vs Profound — https://anny.dodoxhq.com/compare/profound

Both track AI brand mentions and competitor visibility. Anny emphasizes marketing-team UX, broader model coverage including Google AI Mode/Overview, agency multi-client workspaces, and actionable GEO gaps.

Pick Anny for clarity over research-lab complexity, day-one AI Mode coverage, and agency portfolio views.

Pick Profound when already standardized on Profound for enterprise AI audits, or when deep custom research programs matter more than a daily dashboard.
